headline: Washington State Reports Human Bird Flu Death Amid Rising Cattle Outbreaks
summary: A human death from bird flu has been reported in Washington state, coinciding with ongoing H5N1 outbreaks in cattle across multiple U.S. farms and mink populations.
why: The H5N1 virus poses significant risks to the agricultural sector, particularly livestock and poultry, and raises concerns regarding potential public health interventions or trade restrictions.

impacts.name: Agriculture
impacts.why: Outbreaks in livestock can lead to supply chain disruptions and increased regulatory oversight.
